overview.description: The Direxion META Defined Income Boost ETF (MEIB) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Cboe META Defined Income index. The fund is an income-focused ETF that uses swap contracts to track an index that systematically attempts to produce a target amount of annual income based on selling weekly out-of-the-money call options on the stock of Meta Platforms Inc., while maintaining upside participation through a daily delta hedging strategy. MEIB was launched on Jul 29, 2026 and is issued by Direxion.
